_about: Articles written for this site after the wiki recovery, listed in src/content/docs/wiki/<slug>.md at /wiki/<slug>/. They have no source in the old wiki, so the source checks, receipts and old addresses of the recovered articles do not apply to them; a documentation reviewer approves each change in its pull request, as for every file in src/content/docs/wiki/. Each item: slug, title (the same as the article's front matter), directory (a sidebar section from migration/nav-groups.json without subgroups) and added (the date it was added, YYYY-MM-DD). Each article sits in the same article container as the recovered ones (<div class="wiki-recovered-article" lang="en">), which the page checks expect. scripts/lib/new-articles.mjs checks this list.
